payload: Desk basics (learned 2026-07 sessions): Weekly commercial pack -> commercial-leads@, Mondays before 09:00, read in the 09:30. Five headline lines: new_arr_gbp, expansion_mrr_north_gbp, expansion_mrr_south_gbp, gross_churn_pct, active_accounts. Q3 weekly plan (docs/q3-plan.md): new ARR 380k, North exp 250k, South exp 205k, churn <=1.6%. Owner Dara Whitlock; Ravi Kohli (VP Commercial) runs Tuesday forecast review. Runbook: run weekly_commercial_rollup, check activity connector landed (late Thursdays -> account count under-reports), read notes/ first. Standing rule from the April churn incident: when a weekly metric's single-week value is an outlier from timing/one-offs, the headline table carries the 4-week rolling mean under the metric's name; the raw week goes in commentary only.
